name: GC wall clip: two light-flick clips up a wall onto its top
techNote: A 520-tall Ground wall (x -50-50) on a floor, the finish on its top. With no unlocks, a floor jump peaks at 300 and one clip's jump at 442, short of the top (the hitbox bottom is y-34). Jump with your back to the wall (back edge 2 u from it); at Velocity.y under 580 release and flick the stick lightly toward the wall (-0.4): the jump cut drops Velocity.y to 50, the turn swings the hitbox's back edge 10 u into the wall and the depenetration pushes it back only part way, so the next tick's front ground ray (x-25) starts inside the wall and grounds the dot in mid air; the jump pressed with the light flick back (+0.4) is a full ground jump, and it leaves the back edge within 8 u of the wall, so the same wall clips again 10 ticks later. After the second clip's jump, hold toward the wall over its top.
